steps.action: Up from the loading dock on the freight lift
Wait one turn at the freight lift for the 02:00 round to pass
Down the dock corridor, pick the records room door, two turns, and take the files
Back out the way you came

plan.pushback: C2 sweeps the dock corridor every other turn. Your wait at the freight lift gets you past it going in, but not coming out: with the files, wait one more turn at the records door before you cross back, or C2 has you in the corridor.

steps.action: Down the east stair from the roof hatch
Along the main corridor and through office 2210, pick the records room door and take the files
Back up to the roof

plan.pushback: The roof is the long way round. The main corridor between the east stair and the records room is where the rounds walk. The dock is shorter and only a camera watches it.

steps.action: In through the main lobby

Out through the lobby

plan.pushback: The lobby has a desk guard all night. If you go that way, you walk past them twice.
